               "reference_corner.mkv": (1280, 720), "driver_reference.mkv": (1280, 720)}


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _rows(text):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]


def _lines(items):
    return "".join(json.dumps(item, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n" for item in items)


def _body3(vertices):
    return [[x, y, z] for x, y in vertices for z in (0, 1.5)]


def converter_envelope(sources, trace, stops, case_id):
    """Make original-frame diagnostic converter inputs for every saved frame."""
    reference = json.loads((ROOT / "work/testing__C125714__NRS-484B-250-2__motor_vehicle_driver/diagnostic.json").read_text())
    reference_files = reference["files"]
    template = _rows(reference_files["capture/evidence.jsonl"])[0]
    crossings = _rows(sources["crossing_history.jsonl"])
    if len(crossings) != len(trace):
        raise ValueError("Crossing and trace counts differ")
    evidence, frames, graphs = [], [], []
    for row, stop, crossing in zip(trace, stops, crossings):
        frame, time_s = row["frame"], row["time_s"]
        if frame != crossing["frame"] or frame != stop["frame"]:
            raise ValueError("Original frame histories differ")
        ego = crossing["ego"]
        other = crossing["other"]
        speed = row["speed_mps"]
        row.update(speed_mph=speed / .44704, velocity_mps=[speed, 0, 0],
                   control={"throttle": 0, "steer": 0, "brake": 1 if speed == 0 else 0,
                            "hand_brake": False, "reverse": False})
        event = copy.deepcopy(template)
        event.update(original_frame=frame, replay_frame=frame,
                     recording_time_s=time_s, replay_simulation_time_s=time_s)
        event["ego"].update(position_m=row["position_m"], speed_mps=speed,
                            heading_deg=0, body_vertices_m=_body3(ego["body_vertices_xy_m"]))
        event["original_observations"].update(frame=frame, time_s=time_s)
        for actor, state, actor_id, heading in zip(
                event["original_observations"]["participants"], (ego, other), (101, 102), (0, 90)):
            actor_speed = stop["ego" if actor_id == 101 else "other"]["speed_mps"]
            actor.update(actor_id=actor_id, position_m=[*state["position_xy_m"], 0],
                         body_vertices_m=_body3(state["body_vertices_xy_m"]),
                         heading_deg=heading, speed_mps=actor_speed,
                         velocity_mps=[actor_speed * math.cos(math.radians(heading)),
                                       actor_speed * math.sin(math.radians(heading)), 0])
        evidence.append(event)
        base = f"graphs/base/{frame:08d}.adapter.json"
        abstract = f"graphs/abstract/{frame:08d}.adapter.json"
        frames.append({"frame": frame, "simulation_time": time_s, "base": base,
                       "abstract": abstract, "adapter_graph": base, "nodes": 0, "edges": 0,
                       "extraction_seconds": 0, "capture_seconds": 0})
        for graph_path in (base, abstract):
            attributes = {"frame": frame, "simulation_time_s": time_s,
                          "units": {"position": "m"}}
            if graph_path == base:
                attributes["observed_evidence"] = event["original_observations"]
            graphs.append({"path": "capture/native/" + graph_path,
                           "attributes": attributes,
                           "nodes": [], "edges": []})
    sources["trace.jsonl"] = _lines(trace)
    sources["capture/evidence.jsonl"] = _lines(evidence)
    sources["capture/native/frames.jsonl"] = _lines(frames)
    sources["capture/recorder_info.txt"] = reference_files["capture/recorder_info.txt"]
    sources["road.xodr"] = reference_files["road.xodr"]
    manifest = {"status": "draft", "acquisition": "synthetic_diagnostic",
                "case_id": case_id,
                "map": "Carla/Maps/OpenDriveMap", "frames": len(frames),
                "required_observations": [], "extraction_confirmed": True,
                "sources": {"road.xodr": hashlib.sha256(sources["road.xodr"].encode()).hexdigest(),
                            "trace.jsonl": hashlib.sha256(sources["trace.jsonl"].encode()).hexdigest()}}
    sources["capture/manifest.json"] = json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n"
    return graphs


def build(label="operative"):
    if label not in ("operative", "off"):
        raise ValueError("Choose an exact signal case")
    attempt = SOURCE_ROOT / label
    case_id = "testing__C125751__NRS-484B-250-2__motor_vehicle_driver__signal_" + label
    sources = {name: (attempt / name).read_text() for name in SOURCE_NAMES}
    trace = [json.loads(line) for line in sources["trace.jsonl"].splitlines() if line.strip()]
    stops = [json.loads(line) for line in sources["stop_history.jsonl"].splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if len(trace) != len(stops):
        raise ValueError("Diagnostic trace and speed histories differ")
    for row, stop in zip(trace, stops):
        x, y, z = row["position_m"]
        row["position"] = {"x": x, "y": y, "z": z}
        row["heading_deg"] = 0
        row["speed_mps"] = stop["ego"]["speed_mps"]
    graphs = converter_envelope(sources, trace, stops, case_id)
    spec = {"files": {}, "graphs": graphs,
            "videos": [{"path": name, "frames": 1100, "width": size[0],
                        "height": size[1], "fps": 20, "color": "black"}
                       for name, size in VIDEO_SIZES.items()]}
    inspect(spec)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=ROOT / ".runtime-work") as temp:
        generated = Path(temp)
        generate(spec, generated)
        for role, camera in (("head_visibility_review.json", "approach.mkv"),
                             ("other_head_visibility_review.json", "reference_corner.mkv")):
            review = json.loads(sources[role])
            review["source_video_sha256"] = sha(generated / camera)
            sources[role] = json.dumps(review, indent=2) + "\n"
    name_suffix = "" if label == "operative" else "-off"
    source_dir = HERE / ("diagnostic" + name_suffix + "-sources")
    source_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    items = []
    for name, content in sorted(sources.items()):
        path = source_dir / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(content)
        items.append({"path": name, "source": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha(path)})
    path = HERE / ("diagnostic" + name_suffix + ".json")
    path.write_text(json.dumps(spec, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    if path.stat().st_size > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("Diagnostic source spec exceeds worker file size limit")
    relative = str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
    recipe = {"format": "worker-fixture-recipe",
              "sources": items + [{"path": "diagnostic-input.json", "source": relative, "sha256": sha(path)}],
              "generator": {"source": relative, "sha256": sha(path)}}
    recipe_path = HERE / ("diagnostic" + name_suffix + "-recipe.json")
    recipe_path.write_text(json.dumps(recipe, indent=2) + "\n")
    return {"source_spec": relative, "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
            "source_sha256": sha(path), "recipe_sha256": sha(recipe_path)}

"""Stream original BGRA source-camera frames to lossless FFV1 Matroska.

One writer per named source camera. Caller joins Native sensor frame IDs before
writing and closes every encoder before marking the capture sealed.
"""

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


class FFV1Writer:
    def __init__(self, path: Path, width: int, height: int, fps: int = 20):
        path = Path(path)
        if path.exists() or width <= 0 or height <= 0 or fps <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Fresh path and positive video dimensions/rate required")
        self.path, self.width, self.height, self.fps = path, width, height, fps
        self.frames = 0
        self.exit_code = None
        self.process = subprocess.Popen([
            "ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-n",
            "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "bgra",
            "-video_size", f"{width}x{height}", "-framerate", str(fps),
            "-i", "pipe:0", "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-level", "3",
            "-pix_fmt", "bgr0", str(path)],
            stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

    def write(self, bgra: bytes):
        if not isinstance(bgra, bytes) or len(bgra) != self.width * self.height * 4:
            raise ValueError("Native BGRA frame size mismatch")
        if self.process.poll() is not None:
            raise ValueError("Video encoder exited before source closure")
        self.process.stdin.write(bgra)
        self.frames += 1

    def close(self):
        if self.process.stdin and not self.process.stdin.closed:
            self.process.stdin.close()
        code = self.process.wait(timeout=60)
        self.exit_code = code
        error = self.process.stderr.read().decode(errors="replace")
        self.process.stderr.close()
        if code != 0 or self.frames == 0 or not self.path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("FFV1 source encoder failed: " + error[-1000:])
        return {"path": str(self.path), "frames": self.frames,
                "width": self.width, "height": self.height, "fps": self.fps,
                "encoding": "ffv1-lossless"}

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_):
        self.close()

def audit_delivery(case_id, attempt, package, receipt_dir=None):

    attempt, package = Path(attempt), Path(package)

    if config.get("target_signal_state") != CASES[case_id]:

        raise ValueError("Diagnostic fixture must not claim physical acceptance")
    hashes = result.get("source_evidence_hashes")
    if not isinstance(hashes, dict) or not {"video_frames.jsonl", "signal_history.jsonl",
            "crossing_history.jsonl", "stop_history.jsonl", "head_visibility_review.json",
            "other_head_visibility_review.json"} <= set(hashes):
        raise ValueError("Saved result lacks all original participant and device sources")
    for name, expected in hashes.items():
        if not (attempt / name).is_file() or _sha(attempt / name) != expected:
            raise ValueError("Result source hash differs: " + name)
    if _sha(attempt / "capture/evidence.jsonl") != result.get("capture_evidence_sha256"):

    if result.get("trace_reference") != "trace.jsonl" or result.get("video_frame_map_reference") != "video_frames.jsonl":
        raise ValueError("Saved trace or original frame-map reference differs")

    mapping_path = attempt / "video_frames.jsonl"

    if len(mapping) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("Full original frame-map duration required")
    previous_frame, previous_time = -1, float("-inf")
    for index, row in enumerate(mapping):
        frame, time = row.get("carla_frame"), row.get("time_s")
        if (row.get("video_frame") != index or type(frame) is not int or frame <= previous_frame
                or type(time) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(time) or time <= previous_time):
            raise ValueError("Nonmonotone original video frame/time join")
        if index and abs(time - previous_time - .05) > 1e-3:
            raise ValueError("Original source frames are not 20 Hz")
        previous_frame, previous_time = frame, time
    trace = _rows(attempt / "trace.jsonl")

                                  or row.get("time_s") != mapping[i]["time_s"] for i, row in enumerate(trace)):

        raise ValueError("Analysis case or physical-acceptance claim differs")

    entry = measurements["signal_at_entry"]["value"]["at_body_entry"]
    if entry["ego"]["native_state"] != CASES[case_id]:
        raise ValueError("Measured Native state differs from selected case")
    checks = result.get("target_checks")
    if (not isinstance(checks, list) or len(checks) != 1 or checks[0].get("target") != "ego_native_signal_state_at_body_entry"
            or checks[0].get("matched") is not True or checks[0].get("measured") != CASES[case_id]):
        raise ValueError("Saved Native signal target is missing or unmatched")
    for name in ("head_visibility_review.json", "other_head_visibility_review.json"):
        review = _read(attempt / name)
        source = review.get("camera", "") + ".mkv"
        if source not in CAMERAS or review.get("source_video_sha256") != _sha(attempt / source):
            raise ValueError("Signal-head review lacks current source camera: " + name)

        raise ValueError("Saved result lacks all four named original cameras")
    if receipt_dir is not None:
        receipt_dir = Path(receipt_dir)
        receipt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    decodes = {}
    for index, name in enumerate(CAMERAS):
        receipt = audit_video(attempt / name, FRAMES, mapping_sha256=_sha(mapping_path),
                              receipt=(receipt_dir / f"{index}-{name}.json") if receipt_dir else None)
        if receipt["dimensions"] != list(SIZES[name.removesuffix(".mkv")]):
            raise ValueError("Original camera dimensions differ: " + name)
        decodes[name] = {"video_sha256": receipt["video_sha256"], "frames": receipt["frames"],
                         "rgb_sequence_sha256": receipt["rgb_sequence_sha256"]}
    return {"format": "worker-c125751-independent-delivery-audit", "case_id": case_id,
            "original_frame_map_sha256": _sha(mapping_path), "analysis_sha256": _sha(analysis_path),
            "result_sha256": _sha(attempt / "result.json"), "verified_measurements": sorted(measurements),
            "source_decodes": decodes, "software_audit_passed": True,

"""Native opposite-approach discovery candidates for later source review."""
import math


def _route_exits(entry, upstream, step_m, radius_m):
    """Trace bounded Native branches into left and straight route candidates."""
    start = entry.transform
    start_yaw = float(start.rotation.yaw)
    start_xy = (float(start.location.x), float(start.location.y))
    junction_id = int(entry.get_junction().id)
    if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (*start_xy, start_yaw)):
        return {"left": [], "straight": []}
    upstream_pose = upstream.transform
    upstream_xy = (float(upstream_pose.location.x), float(upstream_pose.location.y))
    if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in upstream_xy):
        return {"left": [], "straight": []}
    exits = {"left": {}, "straight": {}}
    frontier = [(entry, 0, [list(upstream_xy), list(start_xy)])]
    seen = set()
    max_steps = int(radius_m / step_m) + 2
    while frontier:
        current, depth, route = frontier.pop(0)
        if depth >= max_steps or id(current) in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(id(current))
        for successor in current.next(step_m):
            pose = successor.transform
            x, y, yaw = (float(pose.location.x), float(pose.location.y),
                         float(pose.rotation.yaw))
            if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (x, y, yaw)):
                continue
            if math.hypot(x - start_xy[0], y - start_xy[1]) > radius_m:
                continue
            if successor.is_junction:
                if int(successor.get_junction().id) == junction_id:
                    frontier.append((successor, depth + 1, route + [[x, y]]))
                continue
            turn = (yaw - start_yaw + 180) % 360 - 180
            kind = "left" if 45 <= turn <= 135 else "straight" if abs(turn) <= 30 else None
            if kind is not None:
                key = (int(successor.road_id), int(successor.lane_id))
                value = {"exit_road_lane": list(key),
                         "exit_xy_yaw": [x, y, yaw],
                         "turn_angle_deg": turn,
                         "route_xy": route + [[x, y]]}
                if key not in exits[kind] or len(value["route_xy"]) < len(exits[kind][key]["route_xy"]):
                    exits[kind][key] = value
    return {kind: [exits[kind][key] for key in sorted(exits[kind])]
            for kind in ("left", "straight")}


def probe_native_opposite_approaches(world, sample_m=2.0, search_radius_m=25.0):
    """Locate Native same-junction opposing entries for later route/site review.

    A pair here is a topology candidate only. It neither establishes a
    median-opening intersection nor proves a left-turn route or intention.
    """
    if (type(sample_m) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(sample_m)
            or type(search_radius_m) not in (int, float)
            or not math.isfinite(search_radius_m)
            or not 0 < sample_m <= 5 or not 0 < search_radius_m <= 50):
        raise ValueError("Finite bounded Native probe spacing/radius required")
    native_map = world.get_map()
    junctions = {}
    for waypoint in native_map.generate_waypoints(sample_m):
        if not waypoint.is_junction:
            continue
        current = waypoint
        upstream = None
        for _ in range(int(search_radius_m / sample_m) + 1):
            predecessors = current.previous(sample_m)
            if len(predecessors) != 1:
                break
            current = predecessors[0]
            if not current.is_junction:
                upstream = current
                break
        if upstream is None:
            continue
        pose = waypoint.transform
        x, y, yaw = (float(pose.location.x), float(pose.location.y),
                     float(pose.rotation.yaw))
        if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in (x, y, yaw)):
            continue
        junction_id = int(waypoint.get_junction().id)
        lane = (int(upstream.road_id), int(upstream.lane_id))
        junctions.setdefault(junction_id, {}).setdefault(lane, []).append((x, y, yaw, waypoint, upstream))
    candidates = []
    for junction_id, lanes in sorted(junctions.items()):
        lane_ids = sorted(lanes)
        for index, first_lane in enumerate(lane_ids):
            for second_lane in lane_ids[index + 1:]:
                matches = []
                for first in lanes[first_lane]:
                    for second in lanes[second_lane]:
                        distance = math.hypot(first[0] - second[0], first[1] - second[1])
                        angle = abs((second[2] - first[2] + 180) % 360 - 180)
                        if distance <= search_radius_m and angle >= 160:
                            matches.append((distance, -angle, first, second))
                if not matches:
                    continue
                distance, negative_angle, first, second = min(
                    matches, key=lambda match: (match[0], match[1],
                                                 match[2][:3], match[3][:3]))
                route_exits = [_route_exits(first[3], first[4], sample_m, search_radius_m),
                               _route_exits(second[3], second[4], sample_m, search_radius_m)]
                candidates.append({
                    "native_map_name": native_map.name,
                    "native_junction_id": junction_id,
                    "approach_road_lanes": [list(first_lane), list(second_lane)],
                    "junction_sample_xy_yaw": [list(first[:3]), list(second[:3])],
                    "left_turn_exit_candidates": [item["left"] for item in route_exits],
                    "straight_exit_candidates": [item["straight"] for item in route_exits],
                    "sample_separation_m": distance,
                    "approach_angle_deg": -negative_angle,
                    "probe_spacing_m": sample_m,
                    "review_status": "candidate_only",
                    "unresolved": ["median-opening and statutory intersection identity",
                                   "source-reviewed route, exit and turn feasibility",
                                   "original approach, intention and trajectory evidence"],
                })
    return candidates


def route_pair_from_candidate(candidate, turning_role, left_index=0, straight_index=0):
    """Build a candidate site input for the two-vehicle geometry checker.

    A caller must review the original Native map/site before adopting this as
    a selected construction. The indices make branch selection explicit.
    """
    if candidate.get("review_status") != "candidate_only" or turning_role not in ("ego", "other"):
        raise ValueError("Unreviewed Native candidate and turning role required")
    if type(left_index) is not int or type(straight_index) is not int or min(left_index, straight_index) < 0:
        raise ValueError("Nonnegative route branch indices required")
    roles = ("ego", "other")
    turn_position = roles.index(turning_role)
    straight_position = 1 - turn_position
    try:
        left = candidate["left_turn_exit_candidates"][turn_position][left_index]
        straight = candidate["straight_exit_candidates"][straight_position][straight_index]
        routes = {turning_role: left["route_xy"],
                  roles[straight_position]: straight["route_xy"]}
        lanes = dict(zip(roles, candidate["approach_road_lanes"]))
    except (IndexError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("Both Native route branches required") from exc
    from opposite_turn_construction import check_routes
    geometry = check_routes(routes, turning_role)
    return {"native_map_name": candidate["native_map_name"],
            "native_junction_id": candidate["native_junction_id"],
            "routes": routes,
            "expected_approach_lanes": lanes,
            "geometry": geometry,
            "review_status": "candidate_only"}


# Independent saved-source audit for the unselected opposite-turn candidate.
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from shapely.geometry import MultiPoint, Polygon
from camera_setup import SIZES

OPPOSITE_CASE = "testing__C125751__NRS-484B-250-2__motor_vehicle_driver__opposite_left_turn"
CAMERAS = tuple(name + ".mkv" for name in SIZES)

def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def _read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())

def _rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def verify_opposite_site_packet(config, base_dir):
    """Bind an opposite-turn site to reviewed source documents, without a physical verdict."""
    reference = config.get("site_review")
    if not isinstance(reference, dict) or set(reference) != {"path", "sha256"}:
        raise ValueError("Hashed opposite-turn site review packet required")
    packet_path = Path(reference["path"])
    if not packet_path.is_absolute():
        packet_path = Path(base_dir) / packet_path
    if not packet_path.resolve().is_relative_to(Path(base_dir).resolve()):
        raise ValueError("Retained opposite-turn site packet required inside attempt")
    if not packet_path.is_file() or _sha(packet_path) != reference["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Opposite-turn site review packet missing or changed")
    packet = _read(packet_path)
    site = config.get("site")
    if (packet.get("format") != "worker-c125751-opposite-site-review-v1" or
            packet.get("review_status") != "candidate_reviewed" or
            packet.get("site") != site or not isinstance(site, dict)):
        raise ValueError("Opposite-turn reviewed site identity differs")
    content = {
        "polygon": {"crossing_polygon_xy_m": site.get("crossing_polygon_xy_m"),
                    "crossing_polygon_source": site.get("crossing_polygon_source")},
        "approaches": {"routes": site.get("routes"),
                       "approach_headings_deg": site.get("approach_headings_deg"),
                       "expected_approach_lanes": site.get("expected_approach_lanes"),
                       "approach_geometry_source": site.get("approach_geometry_source")},
        "governance": {"governed_signal_ids": site.get("governed_signal_ids"),
                       "expected_approach_lanes": site.get("expected_approach_lanes"),
                       "device_inventory_source": site.get("device_inventory_source")},
        "stops": {"selected_stop_references": site.get("selected_stop_references")},
        "cameras": {"cameras": site.get("cameras")},
    }
    docs = packet.get("source_documents")
    if not isinstance(docs, dict) or set(docs) != set(content):
        raise ValueError("Complete opposite-turn source document inventory required")
    diagnostic_only = False
    for kind, expected in content.items():
        ref = docs[kind]
        if not isinstance(ref, dict) or set(ref) != {"path", "sha256"}:
            raise ValueError("Hashed opposite-turn source document required: " + kind)
        path = Path(ref["path"])
        if not path.is_absolute():
            path = packet_path.parent / path
        if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(Path(base_dir).resolve()):
            raise ValueError("Retained opposite-turn source document required: " + kind)
        if not path.is_file() or _sha(path) != ref["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Opposite-turn source document missing or changed: " + kind)
        document = _read(path)
        if (document.get("format") != "worker-c125751-opposite-site-source-v1" or
                document.get("source_kind") != kind or
                document.get("native_map_name") != site.get("native_map_name") or
                document.get("native_junction_id") != site.get("native_junction_id") or
                document.get("content") != expected or
                not isinstance(document.get("review_basis"), str) or
                not document["review_basis"].strip() or
                type(document.get("diagnostic_only")) is not bool):
            raise ValueError("Opposite-turn source identity/content invalid: " + kind)
        diagnostic_only = diagnostic_only or document["diagnostic_only"]
    map_sha256 = None
    if not diagnostic_only:
        map_ref = packet.get("native_map_export")
        if not isinstance(map_ref, dict) or set(map_ref) != {"path", "sha256"}:
            raise ValueError("Hashed original Native map export required")
        map_path = Path(map_ref["path"])
        if not map_path.is_absolute():
            map_path = packet_path.parent / map_path
        if not map_path.resolve().is_relative_to(Path(base_dir).resolve()):
            raise ValueError("Original Native map export required inside attempt")
        if not map_path.is_file() or _sha(map_path) != map_ref["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Original Native map export missing or changed")
        if not map_path.read_bytes().strip():
            raise ValueError("Original Native map export empty")
        map_sha256 = map_ref["sha256"]
    return {"packet_path": str(packet_path), "packet_sha256": reference["sha256"],
            "diagnostic_only": diagnostic_only, "native_map_sha256": map_sha256,
            "physical_site_verified": False,
            "official_device_status_verified": False}

def audit_opposite_candidate(attempt, analysis_path):
    """Independently check a saved candidate's original joins and result bindings.

    This is a software audit of a diagnostic candidate. It does not decode or
    review pixels, confirm the Native scene, or accept a legal conclusion.
    """
    attempt, analysis_path = Path(attempt), Path(analysis_path)
    config, result, analysis = (_read(path) for path in
                                (attempt / "config.json", attempt / "result.json", analysis_path))
    if (config.get("selected_case_id") != OPPOSITE_CASE or
            result.get("case_id") != OPPOSITE_CASE or
            analysis.get("case_id") != OPPOSITE_CASE or
            (config.get("law_id"), config.get("cell_id")) != ("NRS-484B-250-2", "C125751") or
            config.get("turning_role") not in ("ego", "other")):
        raise ValueError("Exact opposite-turn candidate identity differs")
    if (result.get("physical_acceptance_claimed") is not False or
            analysis.get("physical_acceptance_claimed") is not False or
            analysis.get("legal_acceptance_claimed") is not False):
        raise ValueError("Candidate analysis must leave acceptance unresolved")
    reviewed = verify_opposite_site_packet(config, attempt)
    packet_path = Path(reviewed["packet_path"]).resolve()
    if not packet_path.is_relative_to(attempt.resolve()):
        raise ValueError("Retained candidate site packet required inside attempt")
    packet_name = packet_path.relative_to(attempt.resolve()).as_posix()
    for name in ("road_geometry.json", "turn_route_context.json",
                 "stop_context.json", "signal_context.json"):
        if _read(attempt / name).get("site_review_sha256") != reviewed["packet_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Candidate context/site review binding differs: " + name)
    required = {"config.json", "road_geometry.json", "turn_route_context.json",
                "body_history.jsonl", "crossing_history.jsonl", "signal_context.json",
                "signal_history.jsonl", "stop_context.json", "stop_history.jsonl",
                "video_frames.jsonl", "trace.jsonl", "capture/evidence.jsonl",
                packet_name, *CAMERAS}
    hashes = result.get("source_evidence_hashes")
    if not isinstance(hashes, dict) or set(hashes) != required or analysis.get("source_evidence_hashes") != hashes:
        raise ValueError("Complete candidate source hash inventory required")
    for name, expected in hashes.items():
        source = attempt / name
        if not source.is_file() or _sha(source) != expected:
            raise ValueError("Candidate source hash differs: " + name)
    if (result.get("capture_evidence_sha256") != hashes["capture/evidence.jsonl"] or
            result.get("trace_reference") != "trace.jsonl" or
            result.get("video_frame_map_reference") != "video_frames.jsonl" or
            set(result.get("video_references", [])) != set(CAMERAS)):
        raise ValueError("Candidate result source references differ")
    mapping = _rows(attempt / "video_frames.jsonl")
    if len(mapping) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Candidate needs original frame sequence")
    prior_frame, prior_time = -1, float("-inf")
    for index, row in enumerate(mapping):
        frame, time = row.get("carla_frame"), row.get("time_s")
        if (row.get("video_frame") != index or type(frame) is not int or frame <= prior_frame or
                type(time) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(time) or time <= prior_time):
            raise ValueError("Candidate frame map is not monotone")
        prior_frame, prior_time = frame, time
    joins = (("trace.jsonl", "frame", "time_s"),
             ("capture/evidence.jsonl", "original_frame", "recording_time_s"),
             ("crossing_history.jsonl", "frame", "time_s"),
             ("stop_history.jsonl", "frame", "time_s"),
             ("signal_history.jsonl", "frame", "time_s"))

def run_candidate_opposite_turn(world, carla, site, turning_role, blueprints,
                                transforms, release_frames, target_speeds_mps,
                                frames, collect_camera_frames, write_source,
                                camera_factory=None, lookahead_m=5.0):
    """Apply paired controls and retain one original source record per tick."""
    if type(frames) is not int or not 1 <= frames <= 1100:
        raise ValueError("Bounded positive capture frame count required")
    if not callable(collect_camera_frames) or not callable(write_source):
        raise ValueError("Four-camera collector and source writer required")
    progress = {"ego": 1, "other": 1}
    frame_ids = []
    with construct_opposite_turn_pair(world, blueprints, transforms,
                                      site, turning_role) as built:
        actors = built["actors"]
        with ExitStack() as camera_stack:
            if camera_factory is not None:
                collect_camera_frames = camera_stack.enter_context(camera_factory(world, actors))
            for index in range(frames):
                command = command_opposite_turn_pair(
                carla, actors, site, progress, index, release_frames,
                target_speeds_mps, turning_role, lookahead_m=lookahead_m)
                native_frame = world.tick()
                if type(native_frame) is not int or (frame_ids and native_frame <= frame_ids[-1]):
                    raise ValueError("Increasing original Native frame IDs required")
                cameras = collect_camera_frames(native_frame)
                if not isinstance(cameras, dict) or set(cameras) != set(SIZES) or any(
                    type(frame) is not int or frame != native_frame
                    for frame in cameras.values()):
                    raise ValueError("All four camera sources must join original Native frame")
                bodies = {role: _actor(actor, world.get_map())
                          for role, actor in actors.items()}
                if bodies["ego"]["actor_id"] == bodies["other"]["actor_id"]:
                    raise ValueError("Distinct original Native actors required")
                write_source({"native_frame": native_frame,
                          "frame_index": index,
                          "turning_role": turning_role,
                          "camera_source_frames": cameras,
                          "actor_sources": bodies,
                          "applied_decisions": command["decisions"],
                          "physical_or_legal_acceptance_claimed": False})
                frame_ids.append(native_frame)
    return {"frames_recorded": len(frame_ids),
            "first_native_frame": frame_ids[0],
            "last_native_frame": frame_ids[-1],
            "physical_or_legal_acceptance_claimed": False}


def _camera_pose(carla, values):
    if (not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) != 6 or
            any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value)
                for value in values)):
        raise ValueError("Finite six-value camera pose required")
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=values[0], y=values[1], z=values[2]),
                           carla.Rotation(yaw=values[3], pitch=values[4], roll=values[5]))


def _joined_image(queue, frame):
    for _ in range(6):
        try:
            image = queue.get(timeout=10)
        except Empty as error:
            raise ValueError("Missing original source-camera frame") from error
        if image.frame == frame:
            return image
        if image.frame > frame:
            raise ValueError("Source camera skipped original Native frame")
    raise ValueError("Camera frame join exhausted")


def verify_native_signal_governance(site, governed_lights):
    """Read back the two exact signal actors and their governed approach lanes."""
    signal_ids = site.get("governed_signal_ids")
    lanes = site.get("expected_approach_lanes")
    if (not isinstance(governed_lights, dict) or set(governed_lights) != {"ego", "other"} or
            not isinstance(signal_ids, dict) or set(signal_ids) != {"ego", "other"} or
            not isinstance(lanes, dict) or set(lanes) != {"ego", "other"} or
            signal_ids["ego"] == signal_ids["other"]):
        raise ValueError("Two distinct sourced governed Native signal actors required")
    for role in ("ego", "other"):
        light = governed_lights[role]
        if type(signal_ids[role]) is not int or signal_ids[role] <= 0 or light.id != signal_ids[role]:
            raise ValueError("Native signal actor ID differs from reviewed site: " + role)
        expected = lanes[role]
        if (not isinstance(expected, list) or len(expected) != 2 or
                any(type(value) is not int for value in expected)):
            raise ValueError("Sourced approach lane required: " + role)
        try:
            governed = {(int(waypoint.road_id), int(waypoint.lane_id))
                        for waypoint in light.get_affected_lane_waypoints()}
        except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
            raise ValueError("Native signal lane readback unavailable: " + role) from error
        if tuple(expected) not in governed:
            raise ValueError("Native signal does not govern sourced approach lane: " + role)
    return {role: signal_ids[role] for role in ("ego", "other")}


def verify_native_approach_routes(world, carla, site):
    """Read back the reviewed map, route starts and common junction."""
    native_map = world.get_map()
    if not isinstance(site.get("native_map_name"), str) or native_map.name != site["native_map_name"]:
        raise ValueError("Native map differs from reviewed opposite-turn site")
    junction_id = site.get("native_junction_id")
    if type(junction_id) is not int or junction_id <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Reviewed Native opposite-turn junction required")
    routes = site.get("routes")
    lanes = site.get("expected_approach_lanes")
    if not isinstance(routes, dict) or set(routes) != {"ego", "other"} or not isinstance(lanes, dict) or set(lanes) != {"ego", "other"}:
        raise ValueError("Two sourced opposite-turn approaches required")
    found = {}
    for role in ("ego", "other"):
        route, lane = routes[role], lanes[role]
        if (not isinstance(route, list) or len(route) < 2 or
                any(not isinstance(point, list) or len(point) != 2 or
                    any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value) for value in point)
                    for point in route) or
                not isinstance(lane, list) or len(lane) != 2 or
                any(type(value) is not int for value in lane)):
            raise ValueError("Sourced opposite-turn route start and lane required: " + role)
        waypoints = [native_map.get_waypoint(
            carla.Location(x=point[0], y=point[1], z=0.0), project_to_road=False)
            for point in route]
        waypoint = waypoints[0]
        if waypoint is None or [int(waypoint.road_id), int(waypoint.lane_id)] != lane or waypoint.is_junction:
            raise ValueError("Native route start differs from reviewed approach lane: " + role)
        if not any(point is not None and point.is_junction and
                   int(point.get_junction().id) == junction_id for point in waypoints[1:]):
            raise ValueError("Native route does not enter reviewed junction: " + role)
        found[role] = lane
    if found["ego"] == found["other"]:
        raise ValueError("Distinct opposite-turn approach lanes required")
    return found


def _validate_candidate_construction(root, config, site, turning_role,
                                     release_frames, target_speeds_mps, frames,
                                     transforms=None, lookahead_m=5.0):
    """Bind a preseeded exact attempt to the supplied construction inputs."""
    case = "testing__C125751__NRS-484B-250-2__motor_vehicle_driver__opposite_left_turn"
    if (config.get("selected_case_id") != case or
            config.get("law_id") != "NRS-484B-250-2" or
            config.get("cell_id") != "C125751" or
            config.get("turning_role") != turning_role or
            config.get("site") != site):
        raise ValueError("Exact C125751 candidate case/site identity required")
    try:
        site_digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(site, sort_keys=True,
                                                allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
        raise ValueError("Serializable finite candidate site required") from error
    construction = json.loads((root / "construction.json").read_text())
    # The pinned offline/capture launcher writes the full inline proposal at
    # construction.json. Preserve the same binding for direct candidate tests.
    if construction.get("case_id") == case and "candidate_construction" in construction:
        construction = construction["candidate_construction"]
    if (construction.get("selected_case_id") != case or
            construction.get("site_sha256") != site_digest or
            construction.get("turning_role") != turning_role or
            construction.get("release_frames") != release_frames or
            construction.get("target_speeds_mps") != target_speeds_mps or
            construction.get("lookahead_m", 5.0) != lookahead_m or
            construction.get("frames") != frames):
        raise ValueError("Exact C125751 candidate construction differs from attempted controls")
    if (type(frames) is not int or not 2 <= frames <= 1100 or
            type(lookahead_m) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(lookahead_m) or lookahead_m <= 0 or
            not isinstance(release_frames, dict) or set(release_frames) != {"ego", "other"} or
            any(type(value) is not int or not 1 <= value < frames for value in release_frames.values()) or
            not isinstance(target_speeds_mps, dict) or set(target_speeds_mps) != {"ego", "other"} or
            any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0
                for value in target_speeds_mps.values())):
        raise ValueError("Bounded paired candidate control schedule required")
    variant = construction.get("candidate_variant", "primary")
    if variant != "primary" or "candidate_plan" in config:
        from opposite_turn_construction import validate_opposite_fallbacks
        plan = config.get("candidate_plan")
        if not isinstance(plan, dict) or set(plan) != {"primary", "fallbacks"}:
            raise ValueError("Complete predeclared opposite-turn candidate plan required")
        validated = validate_opposite_fallbacks(plan["primary"], plan["fallbacks"], turning_role)
        if variant not in {"primary", *validated["fallbacks"]}:
            raise ValueError("Declared opposite-turn candidate variant required")
        chosen = validated["primary"] if variant == "primary" else validated["fallbacks"][variant]
        attempted = {"site": site, "transforms": transforms,
                     "release_frames": release_frames,
                     "target_speeds_mps": target_speeds_mps, "frames": frames,
                     "lookahead_m": lookahead_m}
        if attempted != {key: chosen[key] for key in attempted}:
            raise ValueError("Opposite-turn candidate differs from predeclared variant")

    poses = {name: _camera_pose(carla, camera_values[name]) for name in SIZES}

        "intersection_id": junction_id,

    if governed_lights is not None:

    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap
    with ExitStack() as stack:

        crossing_stream = stack.enter_context((root / "crossing_history.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1))

                         if governed_lights is not None else None)
        frame_map = stack.enter_context(FrameMap(root / "video_frames.jsonl"))
        frame_times = {}
        original_capture = None

        @contextmanager
        def camera_factory(active_world, actors):
            nonlocal original_capture
            if original_capture_factory is not None:
                original_capture = stack.enter_context(original_capture_factory(
                    client, actors["ego"], root, case_id))
            sensors = stack.enter_context(source_cameras(active_world, actors["ego"], poses))
            queues = {name: Queue() for name in SIZES}
            for name, sensor in sensors.items():
                sensor.listen(lambda image, camera_name=name: queues[camera_name].put(image))
            writers = {name: stack.enter_context(FFV1Writer(root / (name + ".mkv"), *size))
                       for name, size in SIZES.items()}

            def collect(frame):
                snapshot = active_world.get_snapshot()
                if snapshot.frame != frame:
                    raise ValueError("Native snapshot differs from tick frame")
                time_s = float(snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
                if not math.isfinite(time_s):
                    raise ValueError("Finite original Native time required")
                for name in SIZES:
                    image = _joined_image(queues[name], frame)
                    writers[name].write(bytes(image.raw_data))
                frame_map.append(frame, time_s)
                frame_times[frame] = time_s
                return {name: frame for name in SIZES}

            yield collect

        def write_source(record):
            body_stream.write(json.dumps(record, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            bodies = record["actor_sources"]
            time_s = frame_times.pop(record["native_frame"])

            if signal_stream is not None:

                          "state": _native_state(governed_lights["ego"]),
                          "other_native_signal_id": signal_ids["other"],
                          "other_state": _native_state(governed_lights["other"])}
                signal_stream.write(json.dumps(signal, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

        try:
            receipt = run_candidate_opposite_turn(
                world, carla, site, turning_role, blueprints, transforms,
                release_frames, target_speeds_mps, frames,
                lambda frame: None, write_source, camera_factory=camera_factory,
                lookahead_m=lookahead_m)
        except ValueError as error:
            prefix = "Native actor spawn failed: "
            if str(error).startswith(prefix):
                role = str(error)[len(prefix):]
                (root / "spawn_attempt.json").write_text(json.dumps({

                    "site_review_sha256": reviewed["packet_sha256"] if client is not None else None,
                    "physical_or_legal_acceptance_claimed": False},
                    allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            raise
    return receipt


DEVICE_SOURCES = ("signal_context.json", "signal_history.jsonl", "stop_context.json", "stop_history.jsonl")

def analyze_device_sources(root):
    """Join captured stop and governed-light observations to original frames.

    A candidate signal inventory names actors and lanes; official device status
    and statutory governance remain independent review judgments.
    """
    import hashlib
    import turn_context
    root = Path(root)
    base = turn_context.analyze(root)
    paths = {name: root / name for name in DEVICE_SOURCES}
    for name, path in paths.items():
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing opposite-turn device source: " + name)
    hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name, path in paths.items()}
    result_path = root / "result.json"
    if result_path.is_file():
        recorded = json.loads(result_path.read_text()).get("source_evidence_hashes", {})
        for name in DEVICE_SOURCES:
            if recorded.get(name) != hashes[name]:
                raise ValueError("Opposite-turn device source differs from saved result: " + name)
    context = json.loads(paths["signal_context.json"].read_text())
    if (context.get("intersection_id") != base["intersection_id"] or
            not context.get("native_map_id") or
            not context.get("device_inventory_source") or
            context.get("review_status") != "candidate_only"):
        raise ValueError("Sourced candidate signal context required")
    ids = [context.get("native_signal_id"), context.get("other_native_signal_id")]
    if any(type(value) is not int or value <= 0 for value in ids) or ids[0] == ids[1]:
        raise ValueError("Distinct governed Native signal identities required")
    governed = {"ego": (context.get("governed_road_id"), context.get("governed_lane_id")),
                "other": (context.get("other_governed_road_id"), context.get("other_governed_lane_id"))}
    if any(any(type(value) is not int for value in pair) for pair in governed.values()):
        raise ValueError("Sourced governed approach lanes required")
    stop_context = json.loads(paths["stop_context.json"].read_text())
    road_context = json.loads((root / "road_geometry.json").read_text())
    polygon = Polygon(road_context.get("intersection_polygon_xy_m", []))
    if not polygon.is_valid or polygon.area <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Sourced crossing polygon required to verify original stop observations")
    references = stop_context.get("selected_references")
    if (stop_context.get("intersection_id") != base["intersection_id"] or
            stop_context.get("review_status") != "candidate_only" or
            not isinstance(references, dict) or set(references) != {"ego", "other"}):
        raise ValueError("Sourced candidate stop context required")
    for role, reference in references.items():
        if (not isinstance(reference, dict) or
                reference.get("kind") not in ("marked_stop_line", "near_side_crosswalk", "nearest_view_point") or
                not reference.get("geometry_source") or not reference.get("reference_review_source")):
            raise ValueError("Sourced candidate stop reference required: " + role)
        segment = reference.get("segment_xy_m")
        if (not isinstance(segment, list) or len(segment) != 2 or
                any(not isinstance(point, list) or len(point) != 2 or
                    any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value) for value in point)
                    for point in segment) or math.dist(segment[0], segment[1]) <= 0):
            raise ValueError("Finite nondegenerate stop reference segment required: " + role)
    frames = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "video_frames.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    crossing = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "crossing_history.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    signals = [json.loads(line) for line in paths["signal_history.jsonl"].read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    stops = [json.loads(line) for line in paths["stop_history.jsonl"].read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not (len(frames) >= 2 and len(frames) == len(crossing) == len(signals) == len(stops)):
        raise ValueError("Complete original signal, stop, crossing and camera histories required")
    allowed = {"Red", "Yellow", "Green", "Off", "Unknown"}
    observations = []
    for index, (frame, body, signal, stop) in enumerate(zip(frames, crossing, signals, stops)):
        native_frame = frame.get("carla_frame")
        native_time = frame.get("time_s")
        if (frame.get("video_frame") != index or
                any(row.get("frame") != native_frame or row.get("time_s") != native_time
                    for row in (body, signal, stop))):
            raise ValueError("Opposite-turn device original-frame join failed")
        if (signal.get("native_signal_id") != ids[0] or
                signal.get("other_native_signal_id") != ids[1] or
                signal.get("state") not in allowed or signal.get("other_state") not in allowed):
            raise ValueError("Original governed signal identity/state differs from context")
        for role in ("ego", "other"):
            sample = stop.get(role)
            actor = body.get(role)
            if (not isinstance(sample, dict) or not isinstance(actor, dict) or
                    type(sample.get("speed_mps")) not in (int, float) or
                    not math.isfinite(sample["speed_mps"]) or sample["speed_mps"] < 0 or
                    type(sample.get("body_inside_crossing")) is not bool or
                    sample.get("native_road_id") != actor.get("native_road_id") or
                    sample.get("native_lane_id") != actor.get("native_lane_id")):
                raise ValueError("Original stop observation differs from body source: " + role)
            velocity = actor.get("velocity_xyz_mps")
            if (not isinstance(velocity, list) or len(velocity) != 3 or
                    any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value)
                        for value in velocity) or
                    type(actor.get("speed_mps")) not in (int, float) or
                    not math.isclose(actor["speed_mps"], math.hypot(*velocity),
                                     rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9)):
                raise ValueError("Original body speed differs from velocity source: " + role)
            expected_stop = _stop_state(actor, polygon)
            if (not math.isclose(sample["speed_mps"], expected_stop["speed_mps"],
                                 rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9) or
                    sample.get("front_xy_m") != expected_stop["front_xy_m"] or
                    sample["body_inside_crossing"] != expected_stop["body_inside_crossing"]):
                raise ValueError("Original stop observation differs from body geometry: " + role)
            if index == 0 and (actor["native_road_id"], actor["native_lane_id"]) != governed[role]:
                raise ValueError("Original approach differs from governed signal lane: " + role)
        observations.append({"frame": native_frame, "time_s": native_time,
                             "ego_signal_state": signal["state"],
                             "other_signal_state": signal["other_state"],
                             "ego_speed_mps": stop["ego"]["speed_mps"],
                             "other_speed_mps": stop["other"]["speed_mps"],
                             "ego_body_inside_crossing": stop["ego"]["body_inside_crossing"],
                             "other_body_inside_crossing": stop["other"]["body_inside_crossing" ]})
    return {"format": "worker-c125751-opposite-device-sources-v1",
            "intersection_id": base["intersection_id"],
            "native_map_id": context["native_map_id"],
            "source_hashes": {**base["source_hashes"], **hashes},
            "native_signal_ids": {"ego": ids[0], "other": ids[1]},
            "selected_stop_references": references,
            "observations": observations,
            "official_device_judgment": "unresolved",
            "governance_judgment": "unresolved",
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}


def analyze_candidate_opposite_entry(root):
    """Measure paired body entries from saved candidate sources, without priority claims.

    The selected signal-case entry analyzer requires a lateral right-side approach.
    Opposing approaches have no such side, so this path measures entry order only.
    """
    import hashlib
    root = Path(root)
    device = analyze_device_sources(root)
    route_context = json.loads((root / "turn_route_context.json").read_text())
    road_context = json.loads((root / "road_geometry.json").read_text())
    from opposite_turn_construction import check_routes
    body_path = root / "body_history.jsonl"
    if not body_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing original opposite-turn body history")
    body_hash = hashlib.sha256(body_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    result_path = root / "result.json"
    if result_path.is_file():
        recorded_hash = json.loads(result_path.read_text()).get("source_evidence_hashes", {}).get("body_history.jsonl")
        if recorded_hash != body_hash:
            raise ValueError("Opposite-turn body source differs from saved result")
    frames = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "video_frames.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    crossing = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "crossing_history.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    bodies = [json.loads(line) for line in body_path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if len(bodies) != len(frames) or len(crossing) != len(frames):
        raise ValueError("Complete original opposite-turn body/camera history required")
    polygon = Polygon(road_context["intersection_polygon_xy_m"])
    first = {"ego": None, "other": None}
    turning_role = None
    for index, (frame, recorded, crossed) in enumerate(zip(frames, bodies, crossing)):
        native_frame = frame["carla_frame"]
        if (recorded.get("native_frame") != native_frame or
                recorded.get("frame_index") != index or
                recorded.get("actor_sources") != {role: crossed.get(role) for role in ("ego", "other")} or
                not isinstance(recorded.get("camera_source_frames"), dict) or
                set(recorded["camera_source_frames"]) != set(SIZES) or
                any(value != native_frame for value in recorded["camera_source_frames"].values())):
            raise ValueError("Opposite-turn body/camera original-frame join failed")
        role = recorded.get("turning_role")
        if role not in ("ego", "other") or (turning_role is not None and role != turning_role):
            raise ValueError("Stable opposite-turn turning role required")
        turning_role = role
        for party in ("ego", "other"):
            vertices = crossed[party].get("body_vertices_xy_m")
            if (not isinstance(vertices, list) or len(vertices) < 4 or
                    any(not isinstance(point, list) or len(point) != 2 or
                        any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value)
                            for value in point) for point in vertices)):
                raise ValueError("Complete finite original body vertices required: " + party)
            inside = MultiPoint(vertices).convex_hull.intersects(polygon)
            if index == 0 and inside:
                raise ValueError("Opposite-turn original body starts inside crossing: " + party)
            if first[party] is None and inside:
                first[party] = {"frame": native_frame, "time_s": frame["time_s"]}
    if not all(first.values()):
        raise ValueError("Both opposite-turn original body entries required")
    if route_context.get("intersection_id") != road_context.get("intersection_id"):
        raise ValueError("Opposite-turn route and crossing identities differ")
    geometry = check_routes(route_context.get("routes"), turning_role,
                            road_context["intersection_polygon_xy_m"])
    from stop_measurements import analyze as measure_stop
    stop_order = measure_stop(root, {"intersection_id": road_context["intersection_id"],
                                    "first_body_entry": first})
    device_by_frame = {row["frame"]: row for row in device["observations"]}
    signal_at_entry = {
        party: {"frame": first[party]["frame"],
                "time_s": first[party]["time_s"],
                "native_signal_id": device["native_signal_ids"][party],
                "native_state": device_by_frame[first[party]["frame"]][party + "_signal_state"]}
        for party in ("ego", "other")}
    return {"format": "worker-c125751-opposite-entry-candidate-v1",
            "intersection_id": road_context["intersection_id"],
            "turning_role": turning_role,
            "first_body_entry": first,
            "turning_minus_other_entry_time_s": first[turning_role]["time_s"] -
                first["other" if turning_role == "ego" else "ego"]["time_s"],
            "construction_geometry": geometry,
            "signal_at_body_entry": signal_at_entry,
            "stop_order": stop_order,
            "source_hashes": {**device["source_hashes"], **stop_order["sources"],
                              "body_history.jsonl": body_hash},
            "official_device_judgment": "unresolved",
            "statutory_exception_judgment": "unresolved",
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}

from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "c125751_diagnostic_builder", HERE / "build_diagnostic_constructions.py")
_builder = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(_builder)


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _check_controls(path, role, release):
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if len(rows) < 1100:
        raise ValueError("Full original controller history required")
    held_before, driven_after = False, False
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        permission = row.get("release_permissions", {}).get(role)
        control = row.get(role + "_control")
        if type(permission) is not bool or not isinstance(control, dict):
            raise ValueError("Original permission and applied control required")
        if permission != (index >= release):
            raise ValueError("Original permission differs from release schedule")
        hold, brake, throttle = (control.get(key) for key in ("hold", "brake", "throttle"))
        if type(hold) is not bool or any(type(value) not in (int, float) or
                                          not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0 or value > 1
                                          for value in (brake, throttle)):
            raise ValueError("Finite original brake/throttle control required")
        if index < release and hold and brake >= .99 and throttle == 0:
            held_before = True
        if index >= release and permission and not hold and throttle > 0:
            driven_after = True
    if not held_before or not driven_after:
        raise ValueError("Original stop-and-release control transition unproved")
    return {"held_before_release": held_before, "driven_after_release": driven_after,
            "controller_frames": len(rows)}


def audit_axis(attempts, role):
    """Require four fixed-condition captures with a measured entry response."""
    if role not in ("ego", "other") or len(attempts) != 4:
        raise ValueError("Four attempts and one varied release role required")
    rows, fixed = [], None
    for attempt in map(Path, attempts):
        seal_path = attempt / "capture-seal.json"
        if not seal_path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Original Native capture seal required: " + str(attempt))
        seal = json.loads(seal_path.read_text())
        if (seal.get("format") != "worker-sealed-capture"
                or seal.get("provenance_kind") != "native"
                or seal.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not False
                or seal.get("restoration", {}).get("restored") is not True
                or seal.get("frames", 0) < 1100):
            raise ValueError("Incomplete or diagnostic Native capture: " + str(attempt))
        sources = seal.get("sources", {})
        for name in ("config.json", "controller_history.jsonl", "crossing_history.jsonl",
                     "video_frames.jsonl", "trace.jsonl"):
            if not (attempt / name).is_file() or sources.get(name) != _sha(attempt / name):
                raise ValueError("Original source absent from sealed acquisition: " + name)
        config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text())
        release = config.get(role + "_release_frame")
        if type(release) is not int:
            raise ValueError("Varied release index required in every attempt")
        baseline = {key: value for key, value in config.items()
                    if key != role + "_release_frame"}
        if fixed is None:
            fixed = baseline
        elif baseline != fixed:
            raise ValueError("Fixed construction condition changed across release axis")
        controls = _check_controls(attempt / "controller_history.jsonl", role, release)
        measured = _builder.audit_release_attempt(attempt)
        entry = measured["first_body_entry"][role]["time_s"]
        delay = measured["release_to_entry_delay_s"][role]
        if not all(math.isfinite(float(v)) for v in (entry, delay)):
            raise ValueError("Finite original release and entry measurements required")
        rows.append({"attempt": str(attempt), "capture_seal_sha256": _sha(seal_path),
                     "release_frame": release, "entry_time_s": entry,
                     "release_to_entry_delay_s": delay,
                     "control_transition": controls,
                     "source_hashes": measured["sources"]})
    rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["release_frame"])
    if len({row["release_frame"] for row in rows}) != 4:
        raise ValueError("Four distinct release points required")
    entries = [row["entry_time_s"] for row in rows]
    if any(right < left for left, right in zip(entries, entries[1:])):
        raise ValueError("Original body entry reverses release ordering")
    if entries[-1] <= entries[0]:
        raise ValueError("Original body entry did not respond to release variation")
    return {"format": "worker-original-release-axis", "varied_role": role,
            "rows": rows, "measured_entry_range_s": [entries[0], entries[-1]],
            "fixed_config_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(
                fixed, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest(),
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_threshold_claimed": False}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("role", choices=("ego", "other"))
    parser.add_argument("attempts", nargs=4)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(audit_axis(args.attempts, args.role), indent=2))

"""C125751 source-shaped CPU proofs for physical classification and closure.

Synthetic provenance is a classifier input in this diagnostic fixture. It is
not evidence of a CARLA run or a physically accepted crossing.
"""
import argparse
import copy
import json
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "runtime/scenario_pipeline"))
from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, seal_capture
from worker_exchange.saved_processing import record_native_exit, acknowledge_owner_release
from worker_exchange.common import sha


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def write(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def inputs(root, folder, entry):
    construction_path = folder / entry["construction"]
    construction = read(construction_path)
    config = json.loads(next(item["content"] for item in construction["files"]
                             if item["path"] == "config.json"))
    source = folder / ("diagnostic-sources" if entry["case_id"].endswith("signal_operative")
                       else "diagnostic-off-sources")
    write(root / "config.json", config)
    for name in ("trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl", "crossing_history.jsonl"):
        shutil.copy2(source / name, root / name)
    write(root / "acquisition-provenance.json", {"provenance_kind": "synthetic_fixture",
        "diagnostic_fixture": True, "scope": "Synthetic CPU physical-classifier fixture only"})
    return construction


def motion(folder, entry, kind, output):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="c125751-motion-") as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        inputs(root, folder, entry)
        if kind == "incomplete_motion":
            rows = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "crossing_history.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
            first = copy.deepcopy(rows[0]["ego_vertices_m"])
            for row in rows:
                row["ego_vertices_m"] = copy.deepcopy(first)
            (root / "crossing_history.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(row) + "\n" for row in rows))
        elif kind == "missing_evidence":
            (root / "crossing_history.jsonl").unlink()
        result = physical_result(root, {"target_checks": []})
        expected = {"complete_motion": "met", "incomplete_motion": "not_met",
                    "missing_evidence": "unverified"}[kind]
        actual = result["physical_checks"]["maneuver"]["status"]
        if actual != expected or result["maneuver_completed"] != (expected == "met"):
            raise ValueError(f"Physical-classifier mismatch: {actual}, expected {expected}")
        if not result["physical_checks"]["maneuver"]["sources"]:
            raise ValueError("Physical outcome lacks original-source hashes")
        if result["diagnostic_fixture"] is not True or result["physical_acceptance_claimed"] is not False:
            raise ValueError("CPU fixture was misclassified as physical acceptance")
        if kind == "missing_evidence" and "crossing_history.jsonl" not in result["physical_checks"]["maneuver"]["missing_evidence"]:
            raise ValueError("Missing original body history not reported")
        write(output, result)
        print(json.dumps({"case_id": entry["case_id"], "fixture": kind,
                          "maneuver_status": actual, "diagnostic_fixture": True}))


def lifecycle(folder, entry, output):
    saved = folder / ("operative-process-saved-receipt.json" if entry["case_id"].endswith("signal_operative")
                      else "off-process-saved-receipt.json")
    receipt = read(saved)
    if (receipt.get("format") != "worker-saved-processing" or receipt.get("passed") is not True
            or receipt.get("recorded_only") is not True
            or receipt["analysis_revision"]["construction_sha256"] != entry["construction_sha256"]):
        raise ValueError("Current selected recorded-only saved proof missing")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="c125751-lifecycle-") as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        construction = inputs(root, folder, entry)
        write(root / "construction.json", construction)
        (root / "runner.py").write_text(next(item["content"] for item in construction["files"]
                                          if item["path"] == "runner.py"))
        try:
            seal_capture(root, frames=1100, restoration={"restored": True}, errors=[],
                         encoder_exit_codes={"fixture_encoder": 1}, context={"diagnostic_fixture": True})
        except ValueError as error:
            if "unclosed/failed encoders" not in str(error):
                raise
        else:
            raise ValueError("Failed fixture encoder was sealed")
        seal = seal_capture(root, frames=1100, restoration={"restored": True}, errors=[],
                            encoder_exit_codes={"fixture_encoder": 0}, context={"diagnostic_fixture": True})
        try:
            acknowledge_owner_release(root, root / "owner-release.json", True)
        except ValueError as error:
            if "Native process has not exited" not in str(error):
                raise
        else:
            raise ValueError("Owner release preceded Native exit")
        exit_receipt = record_native_exit(root)
        owner = acknowledge_owner_release(root, root / "owner-release.json", True)
        if exit_receipt["capture_seal_sha256"] != sha(root / "capture-seal.json") or owner["native_exit_sha256"] != sha(root / "native-exit.json"):
            raise ValueError("Closure hash join differs")
        events = seal["events"] + [exit_receipt["event"], owner["event"], receipt["events"][0]]
        expected = ["capture_finished", "encoders_closed", "restoration_verified", "native_exit",
                    "owner_released", "saved_processing_started"]
        if events != expected:
            raise ValueError("Saved processing preceded verified closure")
        write(output, {"events": events, "diagnostic_fixture": True,
                       "failed_encoder_rejected": True, "premature_release_rejected": True,
                       "capture_seal_sha256": sha(root / "capture-seal.json"),
                       "native_exit_sha256": sha(root / "native-exit.json"),
                       "owner_release_sha256": sha(root / "owner-release.json"),
                       "saved_processing_receipt_sha256": sha(saved)})
        print(json.dumps({"case_id": entry["case_id"], "events": events,
                          "diagnostic_fixture": True}))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--manifest", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--kind", required=True, choices=("complete_motion", "incomplete_motion",
                                                          "missing_evidence", "lifecycle"))
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    manifest = args.manifest.resolve()
    entry = next((x for x in read(manifest)["cases"] if x["case_id"] == args.case), None)
    if entry is None:
        raise ValueError("Unknown exact physical fixture case")
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if args.kind == "lifecycle":
        lifecycle(manifest.parent, entry, args.output)
    else:
        motion(manifest.parent, entry, args.kind, args.output)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Reproduce the C125751 diagnostic subject-speed judgment sweep.

These are engineering speed targets on a synthetic site, not legal cutoffs or
proof that Native actors reach the requested speed.
"""
import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
